priority_groups.description: Priority 1: Durable limits and attempt accounting

tests.name: InitializeRun_WithLimitConfiguration_SeedsDurableLimitState
tests.description: A new run persists configured budgets and zero-valued counters.
tests.arrange: Provide successful preflight context and a profile containing refinement limits.
tests.assert: Budgets, logical iteration count, cumulative usage, pending flags, attempts, and handoffs are initialized.

tests.name: UpdateDurableCounters_WithRetry_TracksTokensWithoutIterationAdvance
tests.description: Every attempt consumes observed tokens while retries do not create logical iterations.
tests.arrange: Persist a run and create one normal attempt followed by a retry attempt.
tests.act: Update durable counters for both attempts.
tests.assert: Both attempt token totals accumulate and only the normal attempt advances the logical iteration.

tests.name: UpdateDurableCounters_WithMissingUsage_RecordsZeroAndMarker
tests.description: Missing usage is auditable without inflating the token budget.
tests.arrange: Persist a run and provide an attempt with no usage metrics.
tests.assert: Zero tokens are added and the attempt is marked as missing usage.

tests.name: CheckRefinementLimits_AtConfiguredBoundary_BlocksWithReason
tests.description: Iteration, token, hard-token, and regression boundaries stop scheduling deterministically.
tests.arrange: Create records at each configured boundary and one record below every boundary.
tests.assert: Each boundary returns its stable stop reason while the below-limit record schedules.

tests.name: CheckRefinementLimits_WithPendingEvidence_PausesUntilResolved
tests.description: Unresolved evidence blocks autonomous work and clearing it permits work.
tests.arrange: Create otherwise in-budget records with pending evidence set and cleared.
tests.assert: Pending evidence blocks with its stop reason and the cleared record schedules.

tests.name: Workflow_BeforeAgenticStep_UsesLimitGateAndFinalizesWhenBlocked
tests.description: The workflow does not schedule planning or later agentic work after the centralized gate blocks.
tests.arrange: Mock initialization and a blocking limit decision containing the best accepted state.
tests.assert: The gate runs before planning, finalization receives the stop reason, and no planning step is scheduled.

priority_groups.description: Priority 3: Regression stop and worker contracts

tests.name: RegressionRecovery_WithSuccessfulProposal_ResetsConsecutiveCounter
tests.description: A successful accepted proposal breaks the consecutive harmful-proposal sequence.
tests.assert: The consecutive confirmed-regression counter becomes zero.

tests.name: PublishHumanHandoff_AtRegressionThreshold_RecordsThreeAttempts
tests.description: Threshold termination publishes a structured report containing the harmful attempts.
tests.arrange: Persist three confirmed harmful attempt records and best accepted state.
tests.assert: A structured report with stop reason, counters, best state, and three attempts is persisted.

tests.name: WorkflowModule_WithLimitActivities_RegistersContracts
tests.description: Workers register the new limit, counter, and handoff Activity contracts.
tests.arrange: Load the EDD refinement module specification.
tests.assert: All new Activity names and callable entrypoints are declared and registered.

priority_groups.description: Priority 4: Completion coverage for durable orchestration

tests.name: ProgressRecordV5_WithLimitState_SerializesAndRedacts
tests.description: Schema-v5 limit state survives serialization while sensitive attempt data is redacted.
tests.arrange: Create a complete schema-v5 record containing budgets, counters, pending flags, attempts, and handoffs with sensitive values.
tests.assert: All limit fields remain present and sensitive nested attempt values are redacted.

tests.name: Workflow_AfterTokenConsumingSteps_AccountsUsageAndRegates
tests.description: The workflow accounts each token-consuming result and checks limits again before subsequent autonomous work.
tests.arrange: Mock an in-budget run, execution usage, updated durable records, and a gate that blocks before evaluation.
tests.assert: Counter updates follow token-consuming steps and the blocking gate prevents evaluation.

tests.name: RegressionRecovery_WithUnresolvedAndRecoveredEvidence_UpdatesPendingFlags
tests.description: Regression evidence blocks autonomous work until recovery is verified.
tests.arrange: Persist a run, record inconclusive evidence, then record successful recovery.
tests.act: Update the durable pending-evidence state for both outcomes.
tests.assert: The flag is added while unresolved and removed after verified recovery.

tests.name: Workflow_AtThirdConfirmedRegression_PublishesStructuredHandoff
tests.description: The third confirmed harmful proposal stops recovery work and publishes the structured three-attempt report.
tests.arrange: Mock confirmed evidence and a threshold-reaching regression record.
tests.assert: Structured handoff publication occurs immediately and no restore or evaluation is scheduled.

tests.name: UpdateDurableCounters_WithConcurrentAttempts_PreservesEveryUpdate
tests.description: Concurrent attempt completion cannot lose token or iteration updates.
tests.arrange: Create one run and synchronize two concurrent counter updates.
tests.assert: Both attempts and token totals persist with the correct logical iteration count.
